lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple horizontal rows of high-luminance circular pixel clusters arranged in a grid-like formation posterior to the gill slits along the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal spot rows, creating a pseudo-rectangular matrix of high-luminance nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges characterized by a sharp light-to-shadow vertical gradient running across the upper third of the visible lateral flank.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Discrete high-luminance blobs distributed across the lateral surface of the first dorsal fin silhouette.

other_distinctive_markers: A unique labyrinthine or whorl-like white pigment pattern located immediately posterior to the fifth gill slit, consisting of continuous curvilinear markings deviating from the standard discrete blob formation.
